# Akamai Developer and Edge Platform Documentation
> Documentation and technical resources for Akamai’s edge platform, APIs, security, delivery, and compute services.

Akamai provides developer documentation, API references, product guides, and learning resources for building, securing, and operating applications on its global edge platform.

## Documentation Home
- [Developer Portal](https://techdocs.akamai.com/): Main entry point for Akamai product documentation, APIs, and developer resources.
- [Documentation Home](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home): Central landing page for Akamai technical documentation and product guides.
- [API Reference Overview](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/api): Index of Akamai APIs and reference documentation across products.
- [Learning Lab](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/learning-lab): Hands-on tutorials and guided exercises for Akamai products and workflows.
- [Release Notes](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/release-notes): Product and documentation release updates across Akamai services.

## APIs and Developer Tools
- [APIs](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/api): Browse Akamai APIs by product and capability.
- [API Client Authentication](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/set-up-authentication-credentials): Set up EdgeGrid authentication credentials for Akamai APIs.
- [OPEN EdgeGrid for Java](https://github.com/akamai/AkamaiOPEN-edgegrid-java): Java library for authenticating and calling Akamai APIs.
- [OPEN EdgeGrid for Python](https://github.com/akamai/AkamaiOPEN-edgegrid-python): Python library for Akamai API authentication and request signing.
- [OPEN EdgeGrid for Go](https://github.com/akamai/AkamaiOPEN-edgegrid-golang): Go package for Akamai EdgeGrid request signing.
- [CLI](https://github.com/akamai/cli): Command-line interface for interacting with Akamai APIs and developer workflows.

## Application Security
- [Application Security](https://techdocs.akamai.com/application-security/docs): Documentation for web application and API protection products.
- [App and API Protector](https://techdocs.akamai.com/application-security/docs/app-api-protector): Configure and manage protections for web applications and APIs.
- [Kona Site Defender](https://techdocs.akamai.com/application-security/docs/kona-site-defender): DDoS and web application firewall protections for internet-facing properties.
- [Bot Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/bot-manager/docs): Detect, classify, and mitigate automated bot traffic.
- [API Security](https://techdocs.akamai.com/api-security/docs): Discover, monitor, and protect API traffic and behavior.
- [Client-Side Protection & Compliance](https://techdocs.akamai.com/client-side-protection-compliance/docs): Monitor and secure client-side scripts and browser-side risks.

## Delivery and Performance
- [Delivery and Performance](https://techdocs.akamai.com/property-mgr/docs): Documentation for content delivery, caching, and traffic management configuration.
- [Property Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/property-mgr/docs): Create and manage delivery configurations for websites and applications.
- [Ion](https://techdocs.akamai.com/ion/docs): Optimize web performance and resilience for dynamic sites.
- [Image and Video Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/image-and-video-manager/docs): Optimize and transform images and video for delivery.
- [Adaptive Media Delivery](https://techdocs.akamai.com/adaptive-media-delivery/docs): Deliver streaming media with adaptive bitrate optimization.
- [Cloud Wrapper](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-wrapper/docs): Route and balance traffic across multiple cloud environments.

## Edge DNS and Traffic Management
- [Edge DNS](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/docs): Manage authoritative DNS with high availability and performance.
- [Global Traffic Management](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/docs): Direct users to optimal endpoints based on health and geography.
- [Fast DNS](https://techdocs.akamai.com/fast-dns/docs): High-performance DNS service for responsive domain resolution.
- [TrafficPeak](https://techdocs.akamai.com/trafficpeak/docs): Analyze and visualize DNS and traffic patterns.
- [DNS Posture Management](https://techdocs.akamai.com/dns-posture-management/docs): Assess and improve DNS security posture and configuration.

## Edge Compute and Cloud Services
- [Cloud Computing](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-computing/docs): Documentation for Akamai cloud compute, storage, and infrastructure services.
- [Linode API](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/docs): API documentation for managing Akamai cloud resources.
- [EdgeWorkers](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edgeworkers/docs): Build and run JavaScript functions at the edge.
- [EdgeKV](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edgekv/docs): Low-latency key-value storage for edge applications.
- [Container Service](https://techdocs.akamai.com/container-service/docs): Run and manage containerized workloads on Akamai cloud infrastructure.
- [Object Storage](https://techdocs.akamai.com/object-storage/docs): Store and manage scalable object data in the cloud.

## Zero Trust and Enterprise Security
- [Enterprise Security](https://techdocs.akamai.com/enterprise-security/docs): Documentation for zero trust access and enterprise protection products.
- [Enterprise Application Access](https://techdocs.akamai.com/eaa/docs): Provide secure zero trust access to private applications.
- [Secure Internet Access Enterprise](https://techdocs.akamai.com/siae/docs): Protect users with secure web gateway capabilities.
- [Guardicore Segmentation](https://techdocs.akamai.com/guardicore-segmentation/docs): Implement microsegmentation and east-west traffic controls.
- [Prolexic](https://techdocs.akamai.com/prolexic/docs): Defend against large-scale DDoS attacks with managed mitigation.
- [Account Protector](https://techdocs.akamai.com/account-protector/docs): Reduce account abuse, fraud, and credential-based attacks.

## Media and Streaming
- [Media Services Live](https://techdocs.akamai.com/msl/docs): Live video ingest, processing, and delivery workflows.
- [Media Services On Demand](https://techdocs.akamai.com/msod/docs): Prepare and deliver on-demand streaming media content.
- [Adaptive Media Delivery](https://techdocs.akamai.com/adaptive-media-delivery/docs): Stream media efficiently with adaptive delivery controls.
- [NetStorage](https://techdocs.akamai.com/netstorage/docs): Store and deliver content using Akamai’s origin storage platform.
- [Download Delivery](https://techdocs.akamai.com/download-delivery/docs): Accelerate large file and software download distribution.

## Guides and Tutorials
- [Learning Lab](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/learning-lab): Interactive tutorials for common Akamai implementation tasks.
- [Get Started with APIs](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/set-up-authentication-credentials): Learn how to authenticate and begin using Akamai APIs.
- [EdgeWorkers Tutorials](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edgeworkers/docs): Tutorials and examples for edge compute applications.
- [Property Manager Best Practices](https://techdocs.akamai.com/property-mgr/docs): Guidance for configuring delivery behavior and rule trees.
- [Application Security Guides](https://techdocs.akamai.com/application-security/docs): Implementation guidance for security policies and protections.

## Open Source and SDKs
- [Akamai GitHub Organization](https://github.com/akamai): Open source projects, SDKs, integrations, and tooling from Akamai.
- [CLI](https://github.com/akamai/cli): Extensible command-line interface for Akamai developer operations.
- [Terraform Provider](https://github.com/akamai/terraform-provider-akamai): Infrastructure as code provider for managing Akamai resources.
- [EdgeGrid Java](https://github.com/akamai/AkamaiOPEN-edgegrid-java): Java authentication library for Akamai OPEN APIs.
- [EdgeGrid Python](https://github.com/akamai/AkamaiOPEN-edgegrid-python): Python authentication library for Akamai OPEN APIs.
- [EdgeGrid Go](https://github.com/akamai/AkamaiOPEN-edgegrid-golang): Go library for signing Akamai API requests.
- [EdgeWorkers Examples](https://github.com/akamai/edgeworkers-examples): Sample applications and code patterns for EdgeWorkers development.
